output.recommendation: Establish a clear mandate for the competent authority to issue public communications regarding AI-caused outages, similar to Article 23(7) of EU-NIS2-2022. This authority should be able to inform the public or require the operator to do so after consulting with the entity concerned.
output.rationale: [G1] demonstrates that a competent authority can have the power to communicate publicly about significant incidents, including those caused by AI in critical telecom networks. Such a mechanism ensures timely and accurate information dissemination, mitigating the spread of false rumours.
